about:
Matvey Bouhartsev has been developing since the 7th grade. That’s when he wrote the first program in Pascal. Since that time the hobby turned into a profession. Matvey develops software and websites of different levels of complexity. Getting experience, Matvey immediately passes it on: he runs a YouTube channel on which he talks about programming.

Matvey have worked at Yandex for 3 years: after an internship in Kinopoisk he got a job as a frontend developer in Yandex.Eats, then worked for Autonomous transport unit.
videos_about: Blog in Russian about programs and websites: reviews, coding tutorials, and much more.
